name: Awei T80 OWS Bluetooth Air Conduction Earbuds ( 6-Month Official Warranty )
description:
Hear Clearly. Wear Comfortably. Live Freely.

Say goodbye to ear fatigue! The Awei T80 OWS uses air conduction technology for a non-in-ear design, giving you comfort, safety, and freedom while still enjoying powerful sound. Perfect for workouts, outdoor adventures, or daily calls.

🌟 Highlights

Non-In-Ear Design: Enjoy music without blocking your ears – stay aware of your surroundings.

Bluetooth 5.3: Faster, stronger, and more stable wireless connection.

10 Hours Playtime + 300h Standby: Power that lasts all day.

Digital Battery Display: Know exactly how much charge is left at a glance.

IPX6 Waterproof: Resistant to sweat & rain – perfect for sports and outdoor use.

16mm Dynamic Driver: Rich bass, crisp highs, and balanced sound.

Comfortable Ear-Mounted Fit: Secure and pressure-free for long listening sessions.

🔋 Battery & Charging

Earbuds: 110mAh × 2

Charging Case: 450mAh

Charging Time: 2h (USB Type-C)

✅ Awei T80 OWS Earbuds
✅ Charging Case
✅ USB Type-C Cable
✅ User Manual
